role: Oil / Short-Horizon risk coverage for actual committee position mandates across directional and calendar-spread strategies.

risk_horizon.directional_basis: visible annualized volatility rescaled by square-root of time
risk_horizon.calendar_spread_basis: visible weekly spread-change volatility rescaled to the two-week review window

invariants: risk personnel are scoped by oil and short horizon; directional and calendar spread are coverage objects rather than separate personnel identities
the review requires an actual committee position mandate and allocated capital as inputs
the risk department never outputs a recommended strategy capital authorization
hard market facts are independent of risk-personnel capability
lightweight capability may only perturb soft estimates using deterministic information available at the decision cutoff and may not access future truth
risk style expresses review philosophy and may choose to operate inside approved company risk appetite but may never loosen a company limit beyond the approved policy
risk approval may preserve or reduce committee expected positions but may never create direction, enlarge absolute exposure, or cross through zero
the same oil short-horizon risk group may review both directional and calendar-spread strategies
soft stress loss is measured over the two-week review horizon rather than comparing an annualized one-sigma proxy directly with a short-horizon loss limit
tail-risk and model-uncertainty multipliers are applied exactly once to a calendar-spread stress estimate
